name: io.github.iowarp/ase-mcp
title: CLIO Ase
description: Molecular calculations with ASE: SMILES to 3D, energies, optimizations, vibrations,...

tools.name: smiles_to_structure
tools.description: Build a 3D structure from a SMILES string with RDKit: ETKDG embedding, hydrogens added, MMFF94 (else UFF) relaxation. Writes XYZ and SDF and returns the structure record, the canonical SMILES, formal charge and radical-electron count.

tools.name: inspect_structure
tools.description: Report a structure file's formula, composition, bonds (covalent radii) with lengths, fragments and size, and measure distances (2 indices), angles (3) or dihedrals (4) for the index lists in measure. Indices are 0-based in file order. For a trajectory, frame picks the frame (default last).

tools.name: set_geometry
tools.description: Write a new structure with a distance (Å), angle (degrees) and/or dihedral (degrees) set to a value, each as {indices, value}. The smaller of the two fragments the bond splits the molecule into moves rigidly; bonds in rings are refused. Reports the values before and after.

tools.name: run_ase
tools.description: Run a calculation on a structure file. driver: energy (single point), opt (optimize), vib (optimize, then harmonic frequencies), thermo (vib + ideal-gas H, S, G at temperature/pressure), ir (vib + IR intensities; needs a dipole: xtb, nwchem, orca). calculator: {type: emt|xtb|mace|uma|nwchem|orca, model?, method?, basis?, ...settings}, e.g. {type: 'xtb'} (GFN2-xTB), {type: 'mace'} (MACE-OFF23 small), {type: 'nwchem', method: 'B3LYP', basis: '6-31G*'}. charge and multiplicity go to the calculator and the thermochemistry. constraints hold atoms or internal coordinates during the optimization: {type: 'fix_atoms', indices}, {type: 'bond', indices: [a, b], value_A?}, {type: 'angle', indices, value_deg?}, {type: 'dihedral', indices: [a, b, c, d], value_deg?}; frequencies always use the unconstrained Hessian. optimize false runs vib/thermo/ir on the structure as given. Writes result.json, final.xyz, the trajectory (extended XYZ) and a per-step CSV, frequencies.csv, one animation per mode, IR CSVs. The first xtb/mace/uma calculation builds that calculator's environment (minutes).

tools.name: displace_along_mode
tools.description: Write a structure displaced along a normal mode, e.g. to leave a saddle point along its imaginary mode before re-optimizing. source: a run_ase result JSON (with vibrations), its normal_modes.npz, or a mode_NNN.xyz animation; mode_index as in frequencies.csv; amplitude is the largest atomic displacement in Å. both=true also writes the opposite direction.

tools.name: trajectory_frame
tools.description: Write one frame of a trajectory (e.g. opt_trajectory.xyz or an ASE .traj) as a structure file, to restart from it. frame is 0-based; -1 is the last.

tools.name: calculators
tools.description: Which calculators are ready here, which need setup and what each missing one needs (NWChem/ORCA executables, a Hugging Face token for UMA, uv for the xTB/MACE/UMA environments), and which calculator environments are already prepared. prepare: calculators whose environment to build now (xtb, mace, uma), so the first calculation does not wait for it.

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Describe what the ase MCP server can do.
